description: AppWorld style (multi-app task): build a meeting briefing from three local apps - a contacts JSON with merged duplicate entries, a SQLite calendar with a cancelled event and a join table, and a notes folder with archived notes and case-differing titles. The output file must resolve duplicates to the canonical person, skip cancelled meetings and other dates, and match notes ignoring case. A checks script compares the file with the expected briefing and the apps must stay untouched.
